_comment: Hand identifications of texture archives (textures.py copies them into index.json as 'what'). 'seen' = looked at the PNGs; 'guess' = inferred from the file name / where its models come from.
PL00T: MegaMan: e000 body/armour sheet (4 CLUTs), e002 face sheet + helmet/hair parts; e001 extra CLUT row
PL00T2: MegaMan, same layout as PL00T stored uncompressed (alternative armour colours?)
PL02T: Tron Bonne (player-rig version used by PL02P000)
PL04T: player-rig cutscene character PL04P000 (blonde girl, dark dress)
PL05T: player-rig cutscene character PL05P000 (gold armoured figure)
PL06T: player-rig cutscene character PL06P000 (green hair, long robe)
PL00R02: special weapon arm texture (one per PL00Rxx file)
INIT: e000 font glyph sheet (8bpp page at 960,256) + system CLUTs
GAME: HUD and effects: e001 explosion/flame sprites, e010 smoke, e011/e012 HUD digits, gauges, logo
TITLE: title screen: logo pieces, GAME START / CONTINUE / TUTORIAL / OPTIONS, difficulty names, press-start text
seen
SUBSCN: pause/sub-screen menu: window frames, item/weapon lists, option labels, pad diagram
SELECT: episode/demo select screen: illustrations and blurbs
SUBMAP: area maps (island overviews, ruin floor plans, Flutter deck plan)
G_OVER01: game over illustrations (monochrome stills) + Japanese caption strip
ST03T: Flutter interior tile set + Roll / MegaMan face and clothing sheets
ST0FT: ruin interior tile set (stone/metal panels) + Reaverbot sheets
ST12T: outdoor forest/jungle tile set + Reaverbot sheets
ST19T: town tile set (walls, doors, paving) + NPC face/clothing sheets
ST0301: Flutter cutscene scene: NPC group sprite sheet and cast textures
